archive_notes: Official warnings issued by Cyclone Warning Division during Cyclone Fani May 2019

bulletins.wind_forecast: Wind speed reaching 175-185 kmph gusting to 205 kmph likely to impact coastal Odisha.
bulletins.surge_warning: Storm surge of about 1.5 m above astronomical tide likely to inundate low lying areas of Ganjam, Khordha, Puri & Jagatsinghpur.
bulletins.recommended_action: Total suspension of fishing operations. Fishermen out at sea advised to return immediately.

bulletins.wind_forecast: Wind speed 180-190 kmph gusting to 210 kmph over Puri and adjoining Khordha/Jagatsinghpur.
bulletins.surge_warning: Storm surge height 1.5 to 2.0 m in Puri and Jagatsinghpur districts.
bulletins.recommended_action: Evacuation of people from vulnerable coastal low lying areas to safe shelters. Coastal rail traffic regulated.

bulletins.wind_forecast: Gale wind speed reaching 200-210 kmph gusting to 230 kmph over Puri and adjoining coast during landfall.
bulletins.surge_warning: Inundation expected up to 2-3 km inland in Brahmagiri, Krushnaprasad, Puri Sadar blocks.
bulletins.recommended_action: Mass evacuation to multi-purpose cyclone shelters. Stay indoors. Essential services on emergency standby.

bulletins.wind_forecast: Eye of the cyclone made landfall at Puri between 08:00 and 10:00 IST. Wind speed 150-160 kmph over Bhubaneswar and Cuttack moving NE.
bulletins.surge_warning: Severe sea surge in Puri, Astaranga, Kakatpur coast.
bulletins.recommended_action: Post-landfall emergency response: Road clearance by NDRF/ODRAF, medical teams deployment, restoration of telecommunication and power grid.
